page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 32 dedicated physical cores running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the server achieves 28.91 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec.

The CPU supports AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX-512 VNNI), and AES cryptography instructions, which assist in vector calculations and secure data processing. These capabilities are reflected in a Passmark CPU extended instructions score of 28691.75 and an encryption test score of 14168.84. For language model tasks, the instance processes 135M parameter models at 1539.55 tokens/second for prompts and 85.62 tokens/second for generation, while a larger 7B model runs at 45.98 tokens/second for prompts. Given the balanced resource allocation and lack of local storage, this instance is suited for containerized applications, software compilation, database operations, and general-purpose web serving where external storage is utilized.
